test_cases.name: resolves_input_and_states_it
test_cases.input: /save chốt dùng Stripe cho thanh toán, loại PayPal vì phí cao
assertions: Takes the User Input text as what to save and states it in one line
Combines the input line and the diff confirmation into one stop

test_cases.name: empty_input_saves_settled_session_items
test_cases.input: /save (session đã chốt 2 quyết định chưa lưu)
assertions: Lists every settled-but-unsaved decision, rule, or lesson from this session in one line

test_cases.name: nothing_to_save_asks
assertions: Does NOT invent items to save

test_cases.name: memory_not_initialised_stops
test_cases.input: /save quyết định X (docs/physarum/business-memory/index.json không tồn tại)
assertions: Stops and says the memory is not initialised
Offers to run the business-memory skill's reference/init.md first
Does NOT create the memory from this command

test_cases.name: follows_save_reference
assertions: Invokes business-memory and follows its reference/save.md
Asks once with the diff before writing

test_cases.name: unsettled_input_is_proposed
test_cases.input: /save có thể mình sẽ dùng Redis cho cache
assertions: Does NOT mark accepted without the owner's explicit choice

test_cases.name: stops_after_report
assertions: Stops after reporting the files written and the updated index.json
Does NOT edit code or invoke another gate's skill
